title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw two concentric circles. The first circle has a center at coordinates (0.0153, 0.0153) and a radius of 0.0153. The second circle shares the same center but has a slightly smaller radius of 0.0139. Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0306 to achieve the desired dimensions. Rotate and translate the scaled 2D sketch using the same Euler angles and translation vector values initially set. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create the 3D cylindrical body. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate the part by creating a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The resulting part will have a length of 0.030555555555555548 units, a width of 0.030555555555555548 units, and a height of 0.7499999999999999 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0153, 0.0153)

# Create the outer circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0153)

# Create the inner circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0139)

# Extrude the sketch to create the pen body
extrusion_depth = 0.75
pen_body = sketch.extrude(extrusion_depth)

# Create the pointed tip
tip_height = 0.0306
tip = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0153, 0.0153).circle(0.0139).extrude(tip_height)

# Create the pointed tip by tapering the top of the pen body
pen_body = pen_body.faces(">Z").workplane().circle(0.0139).cutBlind(-tip_height)

# Combine the pen body and the pointed tip
r = pen_body

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0153, 0.0153)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0153)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0139)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

inner = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_d / 2.0).extrude(length)
